description: Elections Commission - W. A. K. Janaka Sampath of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - R. M. Dayarathna of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that two members of the Anamaduwa Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral boundary changes and member status declarations related to local government elections.
